drivingQuestion: May rescuers return even from beyond two thousand cubits, given the first clause's limit?
outcomeNote: the contradiction is raised here; the answer falls outside this unit

segments.he: וְכׇל הַיּוֹצְאִין לְהַצִּיל חוֹזְרִין לִמְקוֹמָן. וַאֲפִילּוּ טוּבָא? וְהָא אָמְרַתְּ רֵישָׁא: ״אַלְפַּיִם אַמָּה״, וְתוּ לָא!
segments.en: The mishna teaches: «All who go out to save» lives «may return to their» original «locations» on Shabbat. The Gemara asks: Does this mean that he may return to his original place «even» if he went out «more» than two thousand cubits beyond his limit? «Didn’t the first clause say» that a person who was permitted to travel beyond his Shabbat limit is allotted «two thousand cubits, and no more?»
